chapters.title: Nashar Ward
chapters.intro: You are the Tactician, the analyst behind Petrov's Splinter, a small resistance cell fighting Enyo:Drift for control of Marcov Geist. Your first job is to pull a deep-cover agent, Kate Soulsbury, out of the corporation.

missions.title: Incursion
missions.brief: Strike fast. The Commandos can outrun any ambush, so never end a turn standing in the open.

missions.title: Slaughter
missions.brief: A work crew has been armed and posted as bait. Spread your guns across open ground and cut them down.

missions.title: Extraction
missions.brief: Keep Kate alive and walk her to the eastern edge. Reinforcements will pour in from the north and south.

chapters.title: Power Station
chapters.intro: The Panarchists will back the Splinter if it takes the power station, where their vat-forms are built. It is your first real operation.

missions.title: Incursion
missions.brief: Use cover, duck when your weapon would lose the exchange, and keep the shotguns for corners.

missions.title: The Breach
missions.brief: Hold the control room for six turns. A few jumpy allies will help; place your guns so each door is covered.

missions.title: Assassination
missions.brief: Two rocket launchers guard the target. Kill them early, before they blow your cover away, then focus the marked man.

chapters.title: The Broadcast Studio
chapters.intro: Nox wants to tell the city how the Shape is being used to control it. Your job is to storm the station and keep him on air.

missions.title: Incursion
missions.brief: Get a unit into the guarded zone, and keep Davies behind cover. Two units on one enemy in a corridor is a fair trade.

missions.title: Clearance
missions.brief: A sniper and a grenadier cover the hall. Do not rush them: take the sniper close, the grenadier at any range.

missions.title: Broadcast
missions.brief: Collect the key crates and run for the edge. You only need three, but kill the rocket launcher first.

chapters.title: Blue Daylight
chapters.intro: To keep the Panarchists on side, the Splinter must break the Blue Daylight cult. You will strike three of its strongholds.

missions.title: Defend the Barracks
missions.brief: Hold a zone with too many windows against two snipers. Duck, wait, stand. Do not blow up your own cover.

missions.title: Attack the Chapel
missions.brief: Shotguns win up close and die in the open. Cover every step until you are in range.

missions.title: Projector Takedown
missions.brief: Reach the projector room. A panel in the middle of the complex disables their launcher if you step on it.

chapters.title: Cairn Dwelling
chapters.intro: Cairn Dwelling is the Panarchists' crowning achievement, and Enyo:Drift is attacking it. Help them drive the assault back.

missions.title: Defend the Dwelling
missions.brief: Your first rocket launcher. It destroys cover, which is a gift to you and to the enemy, and its blasts hurt friends.

missions.title: Push Back
missions.brief: Reach the marked zone within ten turns to stop their reinforcements. Their sniper owns the open ground.

missions.title: Shape Purge
missions.brief: Carry data from three nodes to the edge. Three rocket launchers will make it hard. An access panel can silence them.

chapters.title: Novena Quarter
chapters.intro: To win the Blade's support, Nox must meet their leader, Eshe, in person. Clear the area and see him there alive.

missions.title: Defend the Base
missions.brief: The Blade's base is under attack. An allied Commando will help for one turn, then leave. Kill all but one attacker.

missions.title: Counter
missions.brief: Take the fight to them. Rocket launchers in the centre make cover dangerous, so get the shotgun in fast.

missions.title: The Meeting
missions.brief: Escort Nox across the map. A sniper with the longest sight line and a fast shotgun make the best bodyguards.

chapters.title: Ninstar Tower
chapters.intro: Enyo:Drift is attacking the Ninstar headquarters. Your new allies need your help to survive the night.

missions.title: The Lobby
missions.brief: The Ninstar units near the enemy are lost. Flank around the walls and use the rocket launcher to blow holes.

missions.title: Second Floor
missions.brief: Hold the small area while civilians run for their lives. Use shotguns at the entries and rockets to deny ground.

missions.title: The Corridor
missions.brief: Play defensive from good positions and use indirect fire to push them into you. Then clear what is left.

chapters.title: Dillenger's Villa
chapters.intro: Dillenger, a rich engineer inside Enyo:Drift, knows where the corporation keeps its secret base. Storm his fortified home and make him talk.

missions.title: Break the Compound
missions.brief: Walls, windows and unknowns. Scout carefully and break up their line.

missions.title: Security Takedown
missions.brief: Three gun turrets guard the villa. Destroy all of them. They will not move.

missions.title: The Negotiation
missions.brief: Reach Dillenger's study and hold it long enough to make your point.

chapters.title: Site 77
chapters.intro: Site 77 is where Enyo:Drift hides its black projects. Break in, take what you can, and leave it in pieces.

missions.title: Gain Access
missions.brief: Get a unit into the inner area. Their rockets will punish any squad that stops moving.

missions.title: Data Harvest
missions.brief: Carry four data cores out of the complex. Six are available, so pick the ones the guards cannot cover.

missions.title: Set Up the Bomb
missions.brief: Your demolitions expert has to reach the reactor room and survive 2 seconds there. Do not lose him.

chapters.title: The Devastator
chapters.intro: Among the plans stolen from Site 77 is a walking rocket platform. The Splinter has built one of its own.

missions.title: First Encounter
missions.brief: The Devastator fires several rockets per turn. Do not hold back: two to five shots every round.

missions.title: Steal the Plans
missions.brief: Carry the plans to the edge. Let the Devastator break open the buildings while the others guard it.

missions.title: Facility Takedown
missions.brief: Wipe the facility out. Keep the Devastator behind your guns and let it flatten the map.

chapters.title: Brightmoor
chapters.intro: Brightmoor University is the heart of the Blue Daylight cult, and Emmanuele is its quiet prophet. The Splinter moves in.

missions.title: Daylight Raid
missions.brief: Scout, then strike. Two snipers cover the lawns, so approach from the sides.

missions.title: Hostage Situation
missions.brief: Two students are held at the centre. Get them to the edge. They run straight, so clear the path first.

missions.title: Emmanuele's Doubt
missions.brief: Emmanuele is hiding among his guards. Find him in the dark and bring him down.

chapters.title: Brightmoor Core
chapters.intro: Under the campus the cult has opened a way into the Shape itself. You have to shut it.

missions.title: Connection
missions.brief: Gather three data cores from the cult's servers while their rocket launcher keeps you moving.

missions.title: Stop the Charge
missions.brief: Waves of fast shotguns will come for the control room. Hold it for six turns.

missions.title: The Shape Portal
missions.brief: Reach the portal and hold it. The guards are heavily armed.

chapters.title: Brightmoor Finale
chapters.intro: The cult is cornered, and so are you. End it before the building falls.

missions.title: The Library
missions.brief: Narrow aisles and long sight lines. Snipers will punish you if you cross them.

missions.title: Disrupt the Form
missions.brief: Reach the machine and hold it. Three rocket launchers stand in your way, and a panel nearby can silence them.

missions.title: Fighting in the Square
missions.brief: An open square and a big fight. Use grenades, rockets and snipers to make them cross it.

chapters.title: Termon Bank
chapters.intro: The Splinter needs money. The Termon Bank holds the corporation's gold, and your hackers have a plan.

missions.title: Hacking In
missions.brief: Reach the terminal room in the dark without raising the alarm.

missions.title: Break the Vault
missions.brief: Reach the vault, but do not walk in a straight line, or a sniper will pick you off through the windows.

missions.title: Cashing In
missions.brief: Take four crates of money out through the edge exits. Rockets will wreck the building around you.

chapters.title: Open War
chapters.intro: Enyo:Drift has stopped hiding. Squads clash in the open streets, and the Splinter has to hold.

missions.title: Clemens Square
missions.brief: A big open fight. Keep your units together and let them come to you.

missions.title: Rapid Takedown
missions.brief: You have four turns. Move fast, strike hard, and do not stop.

missions.title: Protection
missions.brief: One long turn of fifty seconds. Hold the zone with three units while enemies come in pairs from three directions. Expect to retry.

chapters.title: Finding Nox
chapters.intro: Nox has vanished. The Splinter searches the city for him, and for the one who took him.

missions.title: Save Belaqua
missions.brief: Belaqua, a defected form, is trapped. Get it out through an edge exit.

missions.title: Reaching
missions.brief: Push through to the marked zone without being seen.

missions.title: The Escape
missions.brief: Get your wounded commander to the edge exit. Reinforcements are on their way.

chapters.title: Glass Spire
chapters.intro: Shane's headquarters rises over the city. You will go in from the plaza, and you will not come out the way you went in.

missions.title: Incursion
missions.brief: Scout the lobby in the dark. They have the numbers, so use the walls.

missions.title: Courtyard
missions.brief: A courtyard battle. Use grenades and a rocket to break cover, and kill what runs.

missions.title: Access Control
missions.brief: Bring three access keys to an edge exit. The tower's guards are alert.

chapters.title: Final Hour
chapters.intro: The last stand: at the top of the Spire, the Splinter faces its own mistakes.

missions.title: The Corridor
missions.brief: The Devastator has to reach the objective. Make sure it does not stand up until the nests are blown, and do not get it killed.

missions.title: Ouroboros
missions.brief: Destroy the cover in the middle, then send a shotgun on a suicide run to touch the objective. Stray enemies fight on their own.

missions.title: The Reversal
missions.brief: Defend the stronghold against yourself. If you remember how you fought, six turns is plenty.

chapters.title: The Mandala
chapters.intro: There is nothing left to shoot. Stop for a moment and listen.

missions.title: Mandala
missions.brief: There is no enemy here. Stand still for one turn and listen to what Charon's Hand has to say.
